RECOMMENDATION: IT DEPENDS
LIKELIHOOD: Unknown—these facts do not support a defensible percentage.

An all-male panel raises a legitimate question about representation and safeguards against bias, but does not establish that sex influenced this decision. Your stronger apparent academic record warrants clarification; publication quality, teaching performance, selection criteria and relevant industry experience may also matter.

Follow up now, requesting the written reasons, published criteria, your assessment against them, and any review deadlines. Ask neutrally whether the panel’s composition complied with university policy and applicable equality requirements. Don’t let unanswered correspondence cause you to miss an appeal deadline.

If the explanation reveals inconsistent criteria, procedural breaches or sex-related comments, consider advice from your union or an equality adviser.
